historicalReview.note: Use relationships among parts, rooms and porticoes. The museum treats Villa Rotonda as a particular case. Separate Palladio's published design from later construction and historical ideal proportions from an avatar's movement requirements.

Show Strada Felice linking the Pincio and Santa Maria Maggiore, then the documented crossroads and markers. Identify visibility and route choice as design interpretations. Distinguish later landmarks from the original project.

Use the 1889 Galerie des Machines as a documented large exhibition space. The painting does not give dimensions or material measurements. Distinguish iron and steel, and describe the craft movement as a parallel response to production methods.

Distinguish Ruskin's Truth and Life chapters. Tie the Red House's window size and daylight to room use, and its crafted elements to construction choices. Do not equate craftsmanship with a ban on industrial materials.
In the Sagrada Família example, branching columns evoke trees while carrying loads. Explain the analogy and the structural role separately.

authoredComparison.finding: 111 opening heights tested at constant avatar and width. 1450 mm overlaps, 1600 mm touches, and 1800 and 2400 mm clear the analytic sweep. The latter two change relative scale with the same clearance classification.
authoredComparison.visualDirection: Mark the lintel and body at equal depth, then show grounded traversal and side-view capsule on the same timeline. Confirm contact in the actual engine. Treat tangent as a boundary case and test legibility at 1080 and 375 widths.
